title: Quarterseed OKR draft and All-Staff Café runbook
content:
Purpose:
This is a working draft for a compact company-wide plan were calling "Quarterseed": a tight 8-week focus around 3 cross-cutting OKRs plus an All-Staff "Café" format to surface feedback and alignment. Goal is to get a lean decision-ready set of OKRs for exec sign-off and a playbook for the town session.

Context and intent:
- We need fewer, clearer bets this quarter: shipping runtime cost improvements, certifying two private-deploy reference customers, and tightening SLOs for hosted API.
- This document is intentionally pragmatic: draft KRs emphasize measurable outcomes we can instrument in Console and Finance dashboards.
- Use the All-Staff Café (short lightning + structured table discussion) to validate scope and capture risk signals from teams.

High-level Quarterseed framing (8 weeks):
- Start: week of 2026-03-16 (post leadership review)
- End: 2026-05-11 (bridge to next planning cadence)
- Rhythm: weekly 30-min cross-functional sync (Mon), exec checkpoint (biweekly), retro + demo at end.

Draft OKRs (candidate; each KR should be a distinct metric or gated deliverable)
Objective A: Reduce per-token inference cost for common web workloads (hosted + dedicated)
- KR A1: Reduce average GPU cost per 1M tokens for hosted text-generation by 18% vs baseline (baseline = Jan-2026 running average).
- KR A2: Increase automatic KV/prefix cache hit rate on high-reuse routes to >= 45% (tracked by Console caching dashboard).
- KR A3: Ship and validate 1 new quantization profile and measure quality delta (per prompt set) < 2% BLEU-like regression on eval suite.

Objective B: Raise reliability and predictability for production customers
- KR B1: 95th percentile latency for common request shape (chat-short) < 120ms across hosted regions 90% of time.
- KR B2: Reduce customer-visible incidents impacting throughput by 60% quarter-over-quarter (incident classification: degraded throughput or fallback to lower-tier models).
- KR B3: Certify two Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) with customer-signed runbooks and SOC 2 pre-checklist completed.

Objective C: Make Redwood API first-class for developer velocity and adoption into product flows
- KR C1: Improve sign-up->first-API-call conversion from 28% to 40% (tracked in onboarding funnel).
- KR C2: Publish 6 new quickstarts / reference apps (sample integrations) and get 100 unique forks/stars across repos as early adoption signal.
- KR C3: Ship Console prompt-sets UI for quality-monitoring and link to automated regression alerts (end-to-end integration validated in staging).

Notes on measurability and ownership:
- Each KR must attach to a primary owner (ENG, Product, SRE, Solutions). See action list below.
- We will rely on the Console instrumentation team to provide daily KR dashboards by week 2. Instrumentation spike (JIRA-ENG-3478) is a prerequisite.

Executive summary (for use in top-of-town emails / exec walkthrough):
- Signal: Cost per token trending down after runtime microbatch rollout in Jan, but cache effectiveness is uneven across routes.
- Ask: Exec alignment to prioritize Objective A if we must trade across objectives (cost vs reliability).
- Risk: If Private deployment cert path slips, we delay a visible enterprise sales catalyst. Contingency: offer extended Dedicated trial for at-risk accounts.

All-Staff Café runbook (format to replace a longer town):
- Duration: 75 minutes total; hybrid-friendly.
- Structure: 10 min framing (CEO + Eng Dir), 5 min demo of cost dashboard, 40 min table sessions (4 breakout rounds, 10 min each), 15 min synth + commit, 5 min close.
- Table prompts (rotate):
  1) Where will a 20% unit-cost improvement help your roadmap? (Practical tradeoffs)
  2) What customer signals worry you most about reliability next quarter?
  3) If we trimmed the OKR set to one objective, which and why?
  4) What support/help would your team need to hit KRs this quarter? (tools, priors, hires)
- Facilitators: product ops + one senior IC per table (list: Avery, Marco, Elena, Samir).
- Output capture: Google Form per table + Miro board sticky notes. One person per table designated as scribe.

Communications & pre-reads:
- Pre-read packet (one pager + dashboard links) to go out 72 hours before town. Draft to be distribuuted by comms team (owner: Juno Lee).
- Quick pulse (3 q) to collect top 3 concerns before town; close by 48 hours before.
- Post-town follow-up: prioritized decision log + action owners within 48 hours.

Decision points for execs (what we need sign-off on this doc)
- Pick the primary Quarterseed Objective (A/B/C) if we must do a hard cut.
- Approve the All-Staff Café format and budget for Miro licenses + catering (in-person).
- Greenlight the Private deployment certification schedule and resource allocation (2 SREs + 1 Solutions engineer).

Unresolved questions / parking lot:
- What exactly is the acceptable quality delta for KR A3? Proposed: < 2% as measured by prompt-set micro-eval, but is that too strict? (PK)
- Do we prioritize release velocity for quickstarts (KR C2) or polish and fewer, higher-quality examples? (Product tradeoff)
- Is a 45% cache-hit realistic across mixed traffic? Need data from last 90 days per-route distribution. (Avery)

Immediate next steps (owners + dates):
- Week 0 (by 2026-03-09): Exec sync to pick primary objective and confirm All-Staff date (owner: Priya).
- Week 1 (by 2026-03-20): Instrumentation spike complete; baseline dashboards published (owner: Avery). Linked: JIRA-ENG-3478.
- Week 2 (by 2026-03-27): Finalize OKR wording and commit owners; push into roadmap board (owner: Marco).
- Week 3 (by 2026-04-03): All-Staff Café run; collect table outputs and publish summary (owner: Juno).
- Week 4 (by 2026-04-10): Action plan published and first cross-functional sync cadence running (owner: Samir).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Instrumentation lag prevents reliable KR tracking. Mitigation: add stop-gap manual sampling and daily heat-check email until dashboards are live.
- Risk: competing priorities from Dedicated sales pushes. Mitigation: reserved capacity carve for certification customers or pause KR A1 for one sprint.

Notes to self / draft language for the exec email:
- Subject: Quarterseed proposal: three focused OKRs + All-Staff Café, request for leadership choices
- Body bullets: why this quarter matters, recommended primary objective (A - cost) with rationale, 3 asks (sign-off on objective, All-Staff format, private deployment resource commit).

Appendix (quick links & artifacts):
- Baseline cost spreadsheet: Google Sheet link (finance) [placeholder]
- Eval prompt sets folder: Confluence link (see linked_artifacts)
- Roadmap board: github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap (PR ref in linked_artifacts)

Parking lot items to move into product-ops backlog after sign-off:
- Micro-benchmarking harness (runbook + infra work)
- Developer docs sprint for quickstarts (content + sample code)
- A/B test plan for cache incentives and routing policies

If youre reading this and want to change any wording, add priorities, or nominate a different facilitator, please drop a note in the Slack thread (linked above) — this is intentionally rough and collaborative.

-- Priya
(putting this out to the ops & product leads for feedback; please annotate in-line in the doc and copy execs if you think we need faster alignment)
